title: A Study of LY4247147 in Participants With Obesity or Overweight Who Are Otherwise Healthy
official: A Phase 1, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Single- and Multiple-Ascending Dose Escalation Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, and Pharmacodynamics of LY4247147 in Participants With Obesity or Overweight Who Are Otherwise Healthy
summary:
The main purpose of this study is to understand how safe and well-tolerated LY4247147 is in participants with obesity or overweight who are otherwise healthy. Blood tests will be performed to check how much LY4247147 gets into the bloodstream and how long it takes the body to eliminate it.

The study will be conducted in 3 parts. For each participant in Parts A and C, the study will last about 30 weeks and will include a stay in the Clinical Research Unit (CRU) lasting about 8 nights. For each participant in Part B, the study will last about 39 weeks and will include up to 3 stays in the CRU lasting about 9 nights each.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Are overtly healthy with no comorbidities related to body mass index (BMI), such as type 2 diabetes mellitus or unstable cardiovascular disease.
* Have overweight with a BMI of greater than or equal to (≥) 27 kilograms per square meter (kg/m²).
* Have obesity with a BMI of ≥30 kg/m2.
* Have had a self-reported stable weight for 3 months prior to screening.
* Singapore only: Participants must be 21 to 65 years of age.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have a history or presence of cardiovascular, respiratory, hepatic, renal, gastrointestinal (GI), endocrine, hematological, or neurological disorders capable of significantly altering the absorption, metabolism, or elimination of drugs, or of constituting a risk when taking the study intervention, or of interfering with the interpretation of data.
* Is an individual of childbearing potential (IOCBP).
